Stories to tell

The beginning

My name is Sriraj Yadav, and for the past four years I have been chasing light, patience, and the perfect frame across India's forests, wetlands, and wild places.

The kingfisher that changed everything

It started with birds and it was the Lesser Flamingo that made me fall completely. Capturing it means earning it. Hours of stillness. Learning its habits. Becoming part of the forest.

The philosophy

That same discipline the art of waiting, watching, and being ready shapes everything I shoot. Whether I'm tracking a predator at golden hour, photographing the monsoon-soaked canopy, or working on a modelling project where I bring nature's light and mood into portraiture, every frame is built on the same foundation: presence, patience, and passion.

The dream

"To tell stories of the natural world for National Geographic, BBC, or Discovery — to put the camera in service of conservation, and to make people fall in love with the wild the way I have."
